contents:
[package]
name = "libp2p-relay-manager"
version = "0.4.0"
edition = "2021"
license = "Apache-2.0 OR MIT"
description = "(WIP) Implementation of a relay-manager"
repository = "https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"
readme = "README.md"
keywords = ["libp2p", "p2p", "networking"]
authors = ["Darius Clark"]
exclude = [".gitignore"]

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.97"
futures = "0.3.31"
rand = "0.9.2"

[dependencies.libp2p]
version = "0.56.0"
features = ["relay"]

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.futures-timer]
version = "3.0.3"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dev-dependencies]
env_logger = "0.11.6"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dev-dependencies.libp2p]
version = "0.56.0"
features = ["full"]

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dev-dependencies.tokio]
features = ["full"]
default-features = false
version = "1.46.1"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dev-dependencies.clap]
features = ["derive", "derive"]
version = "4.5.48"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.getrandom]
features = ["wasm_js"]
version = "0.3.3"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.futures-timer]
version = "3.0.3"
features = ["wasm-bindgen"]

[package]
authors = ["Darius C", "Rust-IPFS contributors"]
rust-version = "1.83"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
name = "rust-ipfs"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"
description = "IPFS node implementation"
version = "0.15.0"

[features]
default = ["full"]
full = ["stream", "dns", "tls", "noise", "tcp", "quic", "rsa", "ed25519", "secp256k1", "ecdsa", "websocket", "upnp"]
rsa = ["connexa/rsa", "rust-ipns/rsa"]
ed25519 = ["connexa/ed25519", "rust-ipns/ed25519"]
secp256k1 = ["connexa/secp256k1", "rust-ipns/secp256k1"]
ecdsa = ["connexa/ecdsa", "rust-ipns/ecdsa"]
stream = ["connexa/stream"]
upnp = ["connexa/upnp"]
dns = ["connexa/dns"]
tls = ["connexa/tls"]
noise = ["connexa/noise"]
tcp = ["connexa/tcp"]
quic = ["connexa/quic"]
pnet = ["connexa/pnet"]
webrtc = ["connexa/webrtc"]
websocket = ["connexa/websocket"]
webtransport = ["connexa/webtransport"]
test_go_interop = []
test_js_interop = []

[workspace]
members = ["packages/*", "unixfs", "examples/*"]
exclude = ["archived"]
resolver = "2"

[workspace.dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.100"
async-rt = "0.1.8"
asynchronous-codec = "0.7.0"
bytes = "1.10.1"
cid = "0.11.1"
fs2 = "0.4.3"
futures-timeout = "0.1.3"
futures-timer = "3.0.0"
hickory-resolver = "0.25.2"
idb = "0.6.4"
indexmap = "2.11.4"
ipld-dagpb = "0.2.2"
multibase = "0.9.1"
multihash = "0.19.3"
multihash-derive = "0.9.1"
parking_lot = "0.12.4"
pollable-map = "0.1.7"
quick-protobuf-codec = "0.3.1"
rand = "0.9.2"
rlimit = "0.10.2"
send_wrapper = "0.6.0"
serde_ipld_dagcbor = "0.6.3"
serde_ipld_dagjson = "0.2.1"
serde-wasm-bindgen = "0.6.5"
sha2 = "0.10.8"
simple_x509 = "=1.1.0"
web-time = "1.1.0"
zeroize = "1.8.1"

[workspace.dependencies.async-stream]
version = "0.3.6"

[workspace.dependencies.async-trait]
version = "0.1.89"

[workspace.dependencies.base64]
version = "0.22.1"

[workspace.dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4.42"

[workspace.dependencies.clap]
version = "4.5.48"
features = ["derive"]

[workspace.dependencies.connexa]
version = "0.4.1"
features = ["identify", "dcutr", "gossipsub", "autonat", "relay", "kad", "keypair_base64_encoding", "ping", "request-response", "request-response-misc", "rendezvous", "mdns"]

[workspace.dependencies.either]
version = "1.15.0"

[workspace.dependencies.futures]
version = "0.3.31"

[workspace.dependencies.getrandom]
version = "0.3.3"

[workspace.dependencies.ipld-core]
version = "0.4.1"
features = ["serde"]

[workspace.dependencies.libp2p-relay-manager]
version = "0.4.0"
path = "packages/libp2p-relay-manager"

[workspace.dependencies.multihash-codetable]
version = "0.1.4"

[workspace.dependencies.quick-protobuf]
version = "0.8.1"

[workspace.dependencies.rcgen]
version = "0.13.2"
features = ["pem", "x509-parser"]

[workspace.dependencies.rust-ipns]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "packages/rust-ipns"
default-features = false

[workspace.dependencies.rust-unixfs]
version = "0.5.0"
path = "unixfs"

[workspace.dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.219"

[workspace.dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.145"

[workspace.dependencies.thiserror]
version = "2.0.12"

[workspace.dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1.41"

[workspace.dependencies.tracing-futures]
features = ["futures-03"]
version = "0.2.5"

[workspace.dependencies.tokio]
default-features = false
version = "1.46.1"

[workspace.dependencies.tokio-stream]
default-features = false
version = "0.1.17"

[workspace.dependencies.tokio-util]
default-features = false
version = "0.7.15"

[workspace.dependencies.unsigned-varint]
version = "0.8.0"
features = ["asynchronous_codec"]

[workspace.dependencies.wasm-bindgen-futures]
version = "0.4.50"

[dependencies]
anyhow = "1.0.100"
async-rt = "0.1.8"
asynchronous-codec = "0.7.0"
bytes = "1.10.1"
futures-timeout = "0.1.3"
indexmap = "2.11.4"
ipld-dagpb = "0.2.2"
multibase = "0.9.1"
multihash = "0.19.3"
multihash-derive = "0.9.1"
parking_lot = "0.12.4"
pollable-map = "0.1.7"
quick-protobuf-codec = "0.3.1"
rand = "0.9.2"
serde_ipld_dagcbor = "0.6.3"
serde_ipld_dagjson = "0.2.1"
web-time = "1.1.0"
zeroize = "1.8.1"

[dependencies.async-stream]
version = "0.3.6"

[dependencies.async-trait]
version = "0.1.89"

[dependencies.base64]
version = "0.22.1"

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4.42"

[dependencies.connexa]
features = ["cid", "identify", "dcutr", "gossipsub", "autonat", "relay", "kad", "keypair_base64_encoding", "ping", "request-response", "request-response-misc", "rendezvous", "mdns"]
version = "0.4.1"

[dependencies.either]
version = "1.15.0"

[dependencies.futures]
version = "0.3.31"

[dependencies.ipld-core]
version = "0.4.1"
features = ["serde"]

[dependencies.libp2p-relay-manager]
version = "0.4.0"
path = "packages/libp2p-relay-manager"

[dependencies.multihash-codetable]
version = "0.1.4"

[dependencies.quick-protobuf]
version = "0.8.1"

[dependencies.rust-ipns]
features = ["libp2p"]
version = "0.8.0"
path = "packages/rust-ipns"
default-features = false

[dependencies.rust-unixfs]
version = "0.5.0"
path = "unixfs"

[dependencies.serde]
features = ["derive"]
version = "1.0.219"

[dependencies.serde_json]
version = "1.0.145"

[dependencies.thiserror]
version = "2.0.12"

[dependencies.tracing]
version = "0.1.41"

[dependencies.tracing-futures]
features = ["futures-03"]
version = "0.2.5"

[dependencies.unsigned-varint]
version = "0.8.0"
features = ["asynchronous_codec"]

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies]
futures-timer = "3.0.0"
fs2 = "0.4.3"
hickory-resolver = "0.25.2"
rlimit = "0.10.2"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.rcgen]
optional = true
version = "0.13.2"
features = ["pem", "x509-parser"]

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.simple_x509]
optional = true
version = "=1.1.0"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.tokio]
features = ["full"]
default-features = false
version = "1.46.1"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.tokio-stream]
features = ["fs"]
default-features = false
version = "0.1.17"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dependencies.tokio-util]
features = ["full"]
default-features = false
version = "0.7.15"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies]
idb = "0.6.4"
send_wrapper = "0.6.0"
serde-wasm-bindgen = "0.6.5"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.futures-timer]
features = ["wasm-bindgen"]
version = "3.0.0"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.getrandom]
features = ["wasm_js"]
version = "0.3.3"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.tokio]
default-features = false
features = ["sync", "macros"]
version = "1.46.1"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.tokio-stream]
default-features = false
version = "0.1.17"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.tokio-util]
default-features = false
version = "0.7.15"

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.wasm-bindgen-futures]
version = "0.4.50"

[dev-dependencies]
rand = "0.9.2"
tempfile = "3.17.1"

[dev-dependencies.hex-literal]
default-features = false
version = "1.0.0"

[dev-dependencies.tokio]
features = ["full"]
default-features = false
version = "1.46.1"

[dev-dependencies.rustyline-async]
version = "0.4.6"

[dev-dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
features = ["env-filter"]
version = "0.3.19"

[dev-dependencies.clap]
version = "4.5.48"
features = ["derive"]

[profile.dev.build-override]
debug = true

[package]
name = "rust-ipns"
rust-version = "1.70"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"
description = "Rust implementation of IPNS"
version = "0.8.0"
authors = ["Darius Clark"]
keywords = ["libp2p", "ipfs"]

[dependencies]
serde_ipld_dagcbor = "0.6.3"
cid = "0.11.1"
multihash = "0.19.3"

[dependencies.bytes]
features = ["serde"]
version = "1.10.1"

[dependencies.quick-protobuf]
version = "0.8.1"

[dependencies.serde]
features = ["derive"]
version = "1.0.219"

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4.42"

[dependencies.libp2p-identity]
version = "0.2.12"
optional = true
features = ["peerid", "rand"]

[target."cfg(target_arch = \"wasm32\")".dependencies.getrandom]
features = ["wasm_js"]
version = "0.3.3"

[target."cfg(not(target_arch = \"wasm32\"))".dev-dependencies.clap]
features = ["derive", "derive"]
version = "4.5.48"

[features]
libp2p = ["dep:libp2p-identity"]
default = ["libp2p", "rsa", "ed25519", "secp256k1", "ecdsa"]
rsa = ["libp2p-identity?/rsa"]
ed25519 = ["libp2p-identity?/ed25519"]
secp256k1 = ["libp2p-identity?/secp256k1"]
ecdsa = ["libp2p-identity?/ecdsa"]

[package]
authors = ["Rust-IPFS contributors"]
description = "UnixFs tree support"
edition = "2021"
license = "MIT OR Apache-2.0"
name = "rust-unixfs"
readme = "README.md"
repository = "https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"
version = "0.5.0"

[features]
default = ["filetime"]

[dependencies]
ipld-core = "0.4.1"
ipld-dagpb = "0.2.2"
multihash = "0.19.3"
multihash-derive = "0.9.1"

[dependencies.multihash-codetable]
version = "0.1.4"
default-features = false
features = ["std", "sha2"]

[dependencies.either]
default-features = false
version = "1.15.0"

[dependencies.filetime]
optional = true
version = "0.2.26"

[dependencies.quick-protobuf]
version = "0.8.1"

[dependencies.sha2]
default-features = false
version = "0.10.2"

[dev-dependencies.hex-literal]
default-features = false
version = "1.0.0"

[dev-dependencies.libc]
default-features = false
version = "0.2.170"

[dev-dependencies.multibase]
default-features = false
version = "0.9.1"

[dev-dependencies.tar]
default-features = false
version = "0.4.44"

[dev-dependencies.criterion]
default-features = false
version = "0.7.0"

[[bench]]
name = "ingest-tar"
harness = false

[[bench]]
name = "adder"
harness = false

[package]
name = "vox"
authors = ["Emil Sayahi <sayahie@miamioh.edu>"]
description = "A performant static site generator built to scale."
repository = "https://github.com/emmyoh/vox/"
license = "AGPL-3.0-or-later"
readme = "README.md"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[lib]
name = "vox"
path = "src/lib.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "vox"
path = "src/main.rs"
doc = false
required-features = ["cli"]

[dependencies]
toml = "0.8.19"
liquid = "0.26.9"
liquid-core = "0.26.9"
serde = "1.0.213"
sys-locale = "0.3.1"
latex2mathml = "0.2.3"
thiserror = "1.0.65"
glob = "0.3.1"
futures = "0.3.31"
tracing = "0.1.40"
layout-rs = "0.1.2"
html-escape = "0.2.13"
syntect = "5.2.0"
path-clean = "1.0.1"

[dependencies.chrono]
version = "0.4.38"
features = ["serde", "unstable-locales"]

[dependencies.clap]
version = "4.5.20"
features = ["derive", "cargo"]
optional = true

[dependencies.comrak]
version = "0.29.0"
features = ["syntect", "shortcodes"]
default-features = false

[dependencies.daggy]
version = "0.8.0"
features = ["stable_dag"]

[dependencies.liquid-lib]
version = "0.26.9"
features = ["all", "stdlib", "jekyll", "shopify", "extra"]

[dependencies.ahash]
version = "0.8.11"
features = ["std", "serde", "runtime-rng"]

[dependencies.mimalloc]
version = "0.1.43"
optional = true

[dependencies.ticky]
version = "1.0.2"

[dependencies.miette]
version = "7.2.0"
features = ["fancy", "syntect-highlighter"]

[dependencies.tokio]
version = "1.41.0"
features = ["full"]
optional = true

[dependencies.tracing-subscriber]
version = "0.3.18"
optional = true
features = ["env-filter"]

[dependencies.notify-debouncer-full]
version = "0.4.0"
default-features = false
optional = true

[dependencies.actix-files]
version = "0.6.6"
optional = true

[dependencies.actix-web]
version = "4.9.0"
optional = true

[features]
default = []
cli = ["fs_provider", "dep:mimalloc", "dep:tokio", "dep:clap", "dep:tracing-subscriber", "dep:notify-debouncer-full", "dep:actix-files", "dep:actix-web"]
fs_provider = []
ram_provider = []

[package]
name = "zebra"
authors = ["Emil Sayahi"]
description = "A vector database for querying meaningfully similar data."
repository = "https://github.com/emmyoh/zebra/"
license = "AGPL-3.0-or-later"
readme = "README.md"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"

[lib]
name = "zebra"
path = "src/lib.rs"
crate-type = ["rlib", "dylib", "staticlib"]

[[bin]]
name = "zebra"
path = "src/main.rs"
doc = false
required-features = ["cli"]

[dependencies]
fastembed = "4.3.0"
simsimd = "6.2.3"
space = "0.18.0"
distances = "1.8.0"
candle-examples = "0.8.1"
candle-core = "0.8.1"
candle-nn = "0.8.1"
candle-transformers = "0.8.1"
hf-hub = "0.4.1"
sonogram = "0.7.1"
image = "0.25.5"
rayon = "1.10.0"
symphonia = "0.5.4"
anyhow = "1.0.95"
hamming-bitwise-fast = "1.0.0"
rand = "0.9.0"
fjall = "2.4.4"
serde_with = "3.12.0"

[dependencies.clap]
version = "4.5.23"
features = ["derive"]
optional = true

[dependencies.lz4_flex]
version = "0.11.3"
default-features = false
features = ["frame"]

[dependencies.ticky]
version = "1.0.2"
optional = true

[dependencies.pretty-duration]
version = "0.1.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.indicatif]
version = "0.17.9"
optional = true
features = ["rayon", "improved_unicode"]

[dependencies.viuer]
version = "0.9.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.rodio]
version = "0.20.1"
optional = true

[dependencies.bytes]
version = "1.9.0"

[dependencies.dashmap]
version = "6.1.0"
features = ["rayon", "inline", "serde"]

[dependencies.uuid]
version = "1.11.0"
features = ["fast-rng", "v7", "serde"]

[dependencies.serde]
version = "1.0.217"
features = ["derive"]

[dependencies.bincode]
version = "2.0.0"
features = ["serde"]

[features]
default = []
default_db = []
accelerate = ["candle-core/accelerate", "candle-examples/accelerate", "candle-nn/accelerate", "candle-transformers/accelerate"]
cuda = ["candle-core/cuda", "candle-examples/cuda", "candle-nn/cuda", "candle-transformers/cuda"]
mkl = ["candle-core/mkl", "candle-examples/mkl", "candle-nn/mkl", "candle-transformers/mkl"]
metal = ["candle-core/metal", "candle-examples/metal", "candle-nn/metal", "candle-transformers/metal"]
sixel = ["viuer/sixel"]
cli = ["default_db", "dep:clap", "dep:ticky", "dep:pretty-duration", "dep:indicatif", "dep:viuer", "dep:rodio"]

[source.vendored-sources]
directory = "cargo/vendor"

[source.crates-io]
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"]
git = "https://github.com/dariusc93/rust-ipfs"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
rev = "5d442873fcf9a33571bc2a26f5d3a64bfc4ff71f"

[source."https://github.com/emmyoh/vox"]
git = "https://github.com/emmyoh/vox"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"

[source."https://github.com/emmyoh/zebra"]
git = "https://github.com/emmyoh/zebra"
replace-with = "vendored-sources"
